create_fcc_crystal_by_num_atoms: create a random FCC crystal structure with a specified number of atoms and lattice constant
create_fcc_crystal_by_num_cells: create an FCC crystal supercell with a given number of unit cells per dimension
create_water_box: create a periodic box of randomly placed water molecules with a configurable seed
create_slab_adsorbate: create an FCC(111) slab with an adsorbed molecule, OC20-style tags, and fixed subsurface atoms
create_slab_adsorbate_custom: create a Cu(111) slab with CO adsorbate, vacuum spacing, and FixAtoms constraints on subsurface layers
